The marbled cat is one of the most elusive wild cats on Earth. So rare it wasn't photographed until 1994, and even today it takes a team of researchers with over 1,000 cameras hundreds of hours to capture a single shot. With the help of researchers and photographers across Asia, we've compiled the largest collection of marbled cat footage ever assembled online, including exclusive shots never before seen by the public.

In this video we cover everything known about the marbled cat: its prehistoric-looking anatomy, its monkey-like tail and rotating ankles, its behavior, and the newest insights into its genetics and family tree, and what this living relic reveals about how modern cats evolved.

00:00 The Living Relic
01:01 Primitive Traits & Monkey-Li
title: The Most Footage Ever Assembled of the World's Shyest Cat
